content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices, especially in early days of the 30-day window; adjust forecast upward by 1–3% for the first 5–7 days.
- Overestimates after sharp price spikes (e.g., 70+ → 72+), then overshoots and fails to correct; cap forecast at +5% above recent peak for 3–5 days.
- Underestimates in late window (days 25–30) — model shows mean reversion bias; add 2–4% upward bias for final 5 days.
- Forecast lags true price movements by 2–4 days; shift forecast forward by 1–2 days for next 30-day window.
- Model exhibits “overfitting to recent low” — if last 5 days are below 65, forecast should not drop below 66 unless confirmed by new data.
- Avoid “sudden drop” after high forecast — if model predicts 70+ then drops to 65+, adjust downward only if confirmed by 2 consecutive days of lower prices.
